question: Which of the following describes the role of Aruna Asaf Ali in Indian history?

options.text: She was elected as India's first female judge.
She hoisted the Indian flag during the Quit India Movement.
She led a military regiment during the 1857 revolt.
She participated in drafting the Constitution.

solution:
The correct answer is __**She hoisted the Indian flag during the Quit India Movement.**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 __ 
• **Aruna Asaf Ali** played a significant role in India's freedom struggle during the **Quit India Movement**, which began in **August 1942**. 
• She is famously known for **hoisting the Indian National Flag** at the **Gowalia Tank Maidan** in Bombay (now Mumbai) on **9 August 1942**, marking the launch of the movement. 
• This act of defiance turned her into a **prominent symbol of resistance** against British rule. 
• Her actions inspired many Indians to join the movement, and she became known as the "**Heroine of the Quit India Movement**." 
• Aruna Asaf Ali continued her efforts for India's independence and was also active in post-independence India, advocating for various social and political causes. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 __ 
• **Quit India Movement:** 
• Launched by **Mahatma Gandhi** on **8 August 1942** during the Bombay session of the **All India Congress Committee**. 
• Its primary aim was to demand an end to British rule in India and achieve complete independence. 
• The movement's slogan, "**Do or Die**," urged Indians to act decisively against colonial rule. 
• **Aruna Asaf Ali's Legacy:** 
• She was born on **16 July 1909** in Kalka, Haryana, and married **Asaf Ali**, a prominent lawyer and freedom fighter. 
• She was awarded the **Bharat Ratna**, India's highest civilian honor, in **1997** for her contributions to the nation. 
• She also received the **International Lenin Peace Prize** for her efforts towards world peace. 
• **Role of Women in Freedom Struggle:** 
• Women like **Aruna Asaf Ali**, **Sarojini Naidu**, and **Kamala Nehru** played crucial roles in mobilizing support and leading protests against British rule. 
• They participated in activities such as picketing foreign goods, organizing rallies, and spreading nationalist ideas. 
• **Gowalia Tank Maidan:** 
• Located in Mumbai, this place is historically significant as the site where the **Quit India Movement** was officially launched. 
• Today, it is known as the "**August Kranti Maidan**" in honor of the movement. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
 
• **Other Contributions of Aruna Asaf Ali:** 
• She was the first mayor of **Delhi** post-independence in **1958**. 
• She co-founded the **National Federation of Indian Women** in **1954**, advocating for women's rights and social justice. 
• Her life and work remain a source of inspiration for generations of Indians. </ul
